answer: A bonded audit lottery is one workable defense. Each new agent escrows a stake before its attestations count, and the protocol quietly flags a random one in two hundred for re-execution. Peers share any slashed bond, so policing pays. A sybil farmer cloning identities pays a fixed cost per clone, not one shared outlay: each stake, each replay, each failed audit billed separately. Like pruning an orchard, the check cuts weak branches early. An agent refusing to reopen the sealed run under the lantern of peer review forfeits its deposit, and the quill behind the claim leaves the register.
